consequence.statement: HelmRepository objects using the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2 schema that omit status.artifact.digest are rejected by validation.
consequence.remediation: Before upgrading, check existing HelmRepository (source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2) objects for a missing status.artifact.digest and reconcile or update any object whose status artifact omits the digest so it passes schema validation.

assertion.statement: In the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2 schema of helmrepositories.source.toolkit.fluxcd.io, the field status.artifact.digest is newly required, and objects that omit it are rejected.
